swing_trades.rationale: Trade Christian Watson, whose 147 yards and 2 TDs came in a 22-39 loss and who faces the Jets with GB only -3.5, for Zay Flowers, who posted 150 yards and a TD in a 41-23 win and draws the Saints with BAL -8.5—just monitor his doubtful hamstring status.
Usage-based swap: compare the two Week 1 lines on the board.

Acquiring Bucky Irving secures a high-floor receiving back who caught all seven targets and found the end zone on just 8 carries, and he now draws a dream Week 2 spot vs Cleveland Browns (TB -8.5), while Kenneth Walker III is unlikely to repeat his unsustainable 173-yard outburst from a 23-carry opener.

Trade David Montgomery, who rushed 20 times for 60 yards and two touchdowns in a 31-36 loss, for Chris Olave, who posted 10 receptions for 182 yards but is questionable with a hamstring injury ahead of Sunday's game at Baltimore as an 8.5-point underdog.

Trading Isaiah Likely, who caught all eight of his targets for 78 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-20 win over the Cowboys, for Travis Kelce buys low on an active star who managed 71 yards on five targets in the Chiefs' 31-10 win and now gets a soft Week 2 matchup vs Indianapolis Colts (KC -6.5) while Likely faces the Rams as LAR -7 road underdogs.
